div.head: Ger 1.1
div.ab: [1.1] forðam on manegum landum tilð bið redre ðonne on oðrum: ge yrðe tima hrædra, ge mæda rædran, ge winterdún eac swa, ge gehwilc oðer tilð.
forðam on manegum landum tilð bið redre ðonne on oðrum . ge yrðe tima hrædra . ge mæde mæda rædran ge winterdun eac swa . ge gehwilc oðer tilð
Forðam on manegum landum tilð bið redre ðonne on oðrum: ge yrðe tima hrædra, ge mæda rædran, ge winterdun eac swa, ge gehwilc oðer tilð.

denn auf manchen Landgütern ist die Feldarbeit frühzeitiger als auf anderen: sowohl die Zeit des Pflügens eher, als auch Wiesen[-Mähungen] früher, wie ebenfalls Winterhügel, wie jede andere Landarbeit.

for on many estates field-work is earlier than on others: both the time of ploughing is sooner, and [the mowing of] meadows earlier, and likewise winter-hills [with folds where sheep overwinter?], and every other kind of tillage.
because on some lands duties are ready (earlier) than on others, earlier ploughing times, earlier mowing, earlier winter pasturage likewise, and each other task.
Certain tasks for the land must come before others: earlier plowing times, earlier mowing and winter pasturage also, as well as each other chore.
div.note: B often writes e for æ (‘redre’; compare Rect 5.5). B's ‘mæda’ was altered from ‘mæde’. Liebermann compares Rect 21.4.
